title: Invert Binary Tree
description: Given the root of a binary tree represented as an array in level-order, invert the tree, and return its array representation. The array is in heap order: the children of the node at index `i` are at indexes `2i + 1` and `2i + 2`, and `null` means no node there.

hints.content: Swap the left and right children of every node.
Recursively invert the left subtree, then the right subtree.
Can be done via DFS or BFS queue.

solution.explanation:
Invert binary tree by swapping left and right child pointers recursively.
Time Complexity: O(n)
Space Complexity: O(n)
